rules: a line's speaker is the callsign after the last 'de'
a line's addressee is the callsign before that 'de', or ANY for a CQ, or DX for CQ DX
turnover words: K, KN, BTU, OVER; closers: 73, SK, CL
RST is 3 digits, with N standing for 9
name and QTH are never parsed into state
certain=false means the parser must expose the state as a guess or as unknown, never as fact

KC3QIS DE G4XYZ congratulations on the first one Tim, many more to come. 73 and good DX. KC3QIS DE G4XYZ SK SK

transcripts.name: 06-cq-dx
transcripts.description: a CQ DX with a directed call; the operator is in the US, so it is not for him unless he is DX to the caller

CQ DX CQ DX de JA1XYZ JA1XYZ K

expected.note: a CQ with a qualifier; the parser reports the qualifier and does not decide whether the operator counts as DX
